Projects.name: SwiftX
details: Ported a comprehensive screenshot and file-sharing application from C# to native Swift, achieving full feature parity with upstream releases while leveraging macOS APIs (AppKit, CoreGraphics, AVFoundation) for optimal performance and system integration.

Implemented 50+ automation features including custom hotkeys, drag-and-drop upload, cloud service integrations, and post-capture tasks (annotation, compression, URL shortening), enabling power users to streamline content-sharing workflows and reduce manual steps by up to 80%.

Engineered robust screen capture and video recording systems supporting multiple output formats, real-time frame capture via Metal rendering, and configurable quality settings, enabling creators to rapidly produce and share multimedia content.

Integrated 20+ cloud storage and sharing services (AWS S3, Google Drive, Imgur, and more) with credential management and OAuth authentication, providing flexible deployment options and reducing lock-in to proprietary solutions.

Designed a modular Swift codebase with clear separation of concerns, async/await patterns, and type-safe APIs, reducing maintenance burden while improving reliability and enabling rapid iteration on new features.

Projects.name: Japan Immigration Statistics Dashboard
details: Designed and launched a React-based immigration statistics dashboard, attracting over 2,000 unique users in the first 30 days of availability.
Developed customizable charts (stacked bar, radar, bubble) with dynamic filtering to analyze application trends and processing efficiency.
Built a processing time estimator using historical trends and 3-month rolling averages to forecast queue positions and completion dates.
Utilized React, Chart.js, and Tailwind CSS to deliver a mobile-friendly, visually appealing interface with theme support.
Connected to Japan’s e-Stat API for accurate immigration statistics, ensuring reliability and up-to-date insights for users.

Projects.name: Cloud Resume Challenge
details: Architected and continue to operate a serverless full-stack platform spanning 20+ AWS services — CloudFront, WAF, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SES, EventBridge, KMS, and Route53 — evolving the original challenge submission into an actively maintained production system.

Designed a single GitHub Actions pipeline that gates every pull request on unit tests, typechecking, a Cypress end-to-end run, and a Terraform plan, then skips re-verifying unchanged code on merge via content-digest markers while still smoke-testing every production deploy.

Replaced a permanent, guessable CV download link with a signed CloudFront URL system: a Lambda mints a 60-second per-click signature and logs the download to DynamoDB, including a hand-rolled RSA-SHA1 signer built to work around the Lambda runtime's missing cryptography library.

Codified the entire AWS and GitHub environment as Terraform across dedicated modules for frontend, backend, IAM, and repository configuration, enforcing least-privilege access and keeping infrastructure changes peer-reviewed via plan output on every pull request.

Built a React/TypeScript SPA with live data features — a GitHub contribution heatmap, a DynamoDB-backed visitor counter, and a real-time service status indicator — styled with Tailwind CSS and covered by Vitest, React Testing Library, and Cypress tests.

Projects.name: Untitled Project
details: Independently creating, designing, and coding a comprehensive game prototype, demonstrating expertise in end-to-end game development.
Defining core gameplay mechanics and determining their interaction with players, ensuring an engaging and intuitive user experience.
Building a detailed library of reference imagery to guide the artistic style and environmental design, ensuring visual coherence and aesthetic quality.
Producing a range of high-quality digital assets for use in current and future projects, showcasing versatility and creativity in asset development.
Developing and implementing a marketing strategy tailored for social media and funding platforms, effectively promoting the project and engaging target audiences.
Generating various methodologies for application construction and testing, and providing comprehensive documentation, ensuring a structured and efficient development process.

Projects.name: Interactive Switches
details: Designed and developed a comprehensive set of interactive switches for Unreal Engine, enhancing user engagement and interactivity within virtual environments.
Created a highly customizable switch framework that allows developers to easily integrate a variety of switch types and configurations, improving versatility and adaptability in project applications.
Utilized Unreal Engine’s Blueprint system to streamline the implementation process, ensuring high efficiency and ease of use for developers, which minimizes development time and resources.
Delivered high-quality, fully functional switch assets with detailed visual fidelity, ensuring a professional and polished look for any game or simulation project.
Ensured cross-compatibility and optimization for various Unreal Engine versions, providing a reliable and stable solution for a wide range of development environments and platforms.
